description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a growing team building AI data and developer tools. You will design and build product experiences that make complex AI agent workflows clear and useful, working closely with research and engineering.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build interfaces across the platform and marketplace, from early concepts through launch.

 - Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback understandable and actionable.

 - Partner with research and engineering to turn complex reinforcement learning and evaluation workflows into useful tools.

 - Talk with users, observe where they struggle, and improve the product based on what you learn.

 - Develop reusable interaction patterns and maintain a high bar for usability, visual quality, and implementation.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience in design engineering, product design, or a similar role shipping product interfaces.

 - Full-stack engineering experience, including implementing frontend and backend components of shipped products.

 - Frontend skills and a portfolio of shipped design-engineering work that demonstrates original visual design.

 - Experience shipping products, learning from user feedback, and improving what you build.

 - Technical education or strong technical fundamentals, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.

 - Experience working closely with engineers, researchers, and users; developer tools, data-rich products, or research software experience is valuable.

 - Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, or training data is useful, as is experience building reusable interface patterns and working independently in an early-stage company.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 annually for San Francisco and other major US cities. Visa sponsorship is available. Equity was not specified.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, with remote options in the United States and Singapore.
